title: ortholoma oblongifolium
intro: Ortholoma oblongifolium, commonly known as Orthosiphon aristatus, is a plant species belonging to the family Lamiaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to act as a diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Ortholoma oblongifolium include its potential to treat urinary tract infections, kidney stones, and high blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
